newsitem.title: USA: Littelfuse says sets 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Littelfuse says sets 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: Littelfuse Inc said it declared a two-for-one split of its common stock in the form of a stock dividend.

Stockholders of record as of the close of business on May 20 will receive one additional share for each share held. The additional shares will be distributed to stockholders on June 10, said the fuses manufacturer.
Subject to approvals, each outstanding warrant to purchase shares of common stock will become two warrants with an exercise price of $4.18 per share.
When the stock split is completed, Littelfuse will have about 23.8 million equivalent shares outstanding, it said.

At its April 25 meeting, Littelfuse said its board of directors renewed the company's share/warrant repurchase program through April 25, 1998, authorizing the company to acquire any combination of up to one million pre-split shares or warrants or up two million post-split shares or warrants.
Since the board first authorized a share/warrant repurchase program in 1994, Littelfuse said it has repurchased a total of 1.2 million shares and warrants for a total price of about $37 million.
